positions.name: CalibrationDecisionRecording
positions.frame: how are instrument calibration decisions recorded as settled outcomes?
positions.why: These three expressions form the 'Key decisions' block: src-2 ratifies the section as decision-worthy, src-3 records the instrument identification, and src-4 records the calibration parameters with verification basis. They share a decision-level conviction, authority-ranking framing, and parallel label-colon-value structure — one directional read of settled decision recording.
